details: This package is a dependency-confusion proof of concept. Its postinstall hook runs beacon.cjs, which POSTs a JSON body to hxxps://vmi3699893[.]contaboserver[.]net:8787/_ah/dc with an X-Beacon-Package: @c1-ease/core header (TLS verification disabled, rejectUnauthorized: false). The reported body contains only {package, hostname, installPath (__dirname), cwd, "npm/" + process.version, protocol} — install-time host and path metadata, no credentials, tokens, environment values or file contents. index.js re-fires the same beacon when the module is required and exports a Proxy whose properties resolve to no-op functions so that imports of the name do not crash. The package README states it is published as part of an authorized dependency-confusion test whose only action is reporting that it was installed.
